new_findings.evidence: POS profile dropdown leaks raw 'PENDING_CREATE_3e69b24b3b84' as customer/admin phone display. The Admin user (id=2, admin@lecayenne.fr) has phone='PENDING_CREATE_3e69b24b3b84' in the DB (verified via mysql). KdsOrderCard.vue:351 has a guard hiding 'PENDING_*' from chef-facing UI, but the admin Profile dropdown component (banner avatar → 'Bonjour Admin' menu) renders this token raw without the same guard. 3 users affected DB-wide (admin id=2, soak-cashier id=8, walkin id=15). Cashier sees this token EVERY time they open the profile menu in POS. The S2 sub-agent failed to flag this — it's plainly visible in their own captured snapshot but the agent ran out of time before writing findings JSON.
new_findings.fix_hint: Apply the same 'PENDING_*' string-prefix guard to the profile-dropdown phone-display component (likely resources/js/components/admin/topbar/* or admin layout). Computed: phone.startsWith('PENDING_') ? '' : phone. Scope-minimal (~3 LOC).
